title: LinkLayer fragmentation accepts structurally invalid SCHC payloads
description: Python LinkLayer.create_fragment_sender checks only the first Rule ID byte and authenticated peer version, not canonical decompression/structure through the peer context. A compatible caller can fragment truncated or noncanonical Rule0-7 payloads or Rule255 garbage. Validate the entire SCHC packet against the exact current authenticated peer context before session allocation and ensure Rule255 carries canonical full IPv6. Add malformed/truncation/padding/Rule255 and no-state-consumption tests.
